meta.name: Minimum Wage
meta.description: Teens struggle to run a local pizzeria while juggling school, a manic boss and minimum wage in this series based on the hit social media shorts.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: When the shop's eccentric owner drops by, the staff walks him through their daily routines while he wonders whether to keep the place open or sell it.

videos.title: Drama Club
videos.overview: After a secret fling with Julia's mom, Luke flexes his fatherly side with a party of drama students who makes things difficult for Julia and the crew.

videos.title: Breakup
videos.overview: A couple's public break-up at the restaurant sparks a gender divide among the staff with the guys and the girls taking different sides.

videos.title: Birthday Cake
videos.overview: Ryan plans a special surprise for Grace's birthday involving a giant cake, while Luke, Tommy and Julia lock themselves on the roof.

videos.title: No Phones
videos.overview: While Aidan stresses over hair loss, a new "no phones" policy at the pizzeria forces the staff into helping Tommy confront his girlfriend.

videos.title: Lottery Tickets
videos.overview: The staff finds a stack of lottery tickets and imagines how their lives could change. Their big dreams spiral into chaos — but result in a hot tub.

videos.title: Scouts of America
videos.overview: Ryan tries to put the finishing touches on his college application essay while a troop of young scouts takes over the pizza place for the day.

videos.title: Restaurant Rules
videos.overview: The crew struggles when Mr. Sylvester requires them to sing and dance to provide a better customer experience.

videos.title: Sleepover
videos.overview: Julia convinces the crew to come over for a sleepover at her house, but the night doesn't go smoothly — especially with a pet spider on the loose.

videos.title: Prank Call
videos.overview: Hyde joins forces with Julia to track down the pizza shop's notorious prank caller, and Tommy goes around with an odd request to pass a test.

videos.title: New Girl
videos.overview: A new female employee creates a rift between the girls and the guys, leading the boys to lean heavily into their masculinity like never before.

videos.title: Commercial
videos.overview: When Mr. Sylvester needs the staff to shoot a TV commercial, Tommy takes the director's chair and Luke gets ready for his breakout role.

videos.title: Teachers at Work
videos.overview: Aidan searches for a nickname while the rest of the staff gathers evidence after witnessing what they think is an affair between two of their teachers.

videos.title: New Year's Eve
videos.overview: The crew must decide who will work on New Year's Eve. During the holiday shift, Tommy has relationship trouble, and Julia tries to get her first kiss.
